title: Mandate 48 tightened: agents keep the local release binary updated
goal: CEO directive 2026-11-12: agents must keep the local release binary updated with the remote binary, whenever feasible and required. Mandate 48 said the installed copy tracks the latest qualified release and that falling behind is reported. State the duty, with what 'required' and 'feasible' mean, in .agents/identity.json, AGENTS.md and docs/releases.md. The check and the automatic updater start are Commercial T-CLAUDECOMMRELEASECURRENT-1. Text only.
limitations: The duty covers the installed susi release. The shared susi-commercial workflow tool in ~/.cargo/bin is built from main by agents and is not a qualified release; it is outside this rule.

reuse.searched: Both repositories: the updater (scripts/susi-release-sync.sh) and the workflow check already exist; this is wording only.
